title: This Spider Eats Only Other Spiders, and Stabs Them From a Neck
subject: pelican spider

scenes.text: Spiders are the deadliest thing on a spider's menu. One hunter eats nothing else.
It's the pelican spider, about the size of a grain of rice, with a neck like a tiny crane.
It doesn't build a web. It creeps up to another spider's web and plucks it, like a lure.
When the owner comes to check, the neck swings up, and the jaws on the end stab down.
That long neck holds the struggling victim far away, out of reach of its own venom, until it dies.
Its family has been doing this for around 170 million years. A spider that hunts spiders, from a safe distance.

description:
Pelican spiders eat only other spiders, and they hunt them with a neck.
They pluck a web to lure the owner, then stab it from far enough away to stay safe from its venom.
Would you trust a spider that hunts spiders? Tell us below.
first_comment: One study of Madagascan pelican spiders described 26 species, 18 of them new to science. Spider or crane: what does it look like to you?
